description: The heading that names a section inside a page or a panel: the voice of a card title, one step larger. Rank comes from size and colour, not from caps. Copy: names what the section holds, in the reader's words. It is a heading and reads like one — not a shouted category.

props.name: as
props.description: The heading level, and whether this is a heading at all. Give it on a page: a section nobody can reach by walking the outline is a section a screen reader has to scroll for. Pick the level from the page, not from the look — one step under whatever heading contains it, never skipping one. Left off it renders a div, which is right inside a card, where the card's own title is already the heading.
